answer_1.quote: We extend the plug-and-play language model (PPLM) to combine our style classifiers trained on XSLUE with the pre-trained generator; GPT2 without extra fine-tuning: P(x|s) ∝ P(x) • P(s|x). ... We generate text conditioned on single styles and on combinations of styles.

answer_2.quote: In automatic evaluation, we calculate F1 score of generated text using the fine‑tuned classifiers, to check whether the output text reflects stylistic factor of the target style given.

answer_4.quote: Three numbers in human evaluation means stylistic appropriateness, consistency with prompt, and overall coherence in order. ... evaluation scores (1‑5 Likert scale) annotated by three crowd‑workers are averaged on three metrics: stylistic appropriateness, consistency with prompt, and overall coherence.
answer_4.guideline: Crowd workers rate each generated continuation on stylistic appropriateness, consistency with the prompt, and overall coherence using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
